intro: Common questions from wholesale, project, and distributor buyers.

items.question: What information is needed for a quotation?
items.answer: Send product type, material, dimensions or drawings, finish, edge profile, cutouts, quantity, packaging requirements, destination, and target timing.

items.question: Can WHITEROCK make custom sizes and shapes?
items.answer: Yes. Custom work is reviewed against drawings, material limits, tooling, tolerance, quantity, packing, and handling requirements before quotation.

items.question: How are samples approved?
items.answer: The buyer confirms material, color direction, finish, thickness, and acceptable variation. Natural stone remains subject to lot variation, so final approval should use a physical sample or lot reference.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: MOQ depends on material, product type, fabrication complexity, packing method, and production planning. Final MOQ is confirmed in the quotation, not assumed from the website.

items.question: What production lead time should buyers expect?
items.answer: Lead time is confirmed after drawings, sample approval, deposit terms, material availability, and packaging requirements are reviewed. The website guidance is indicative only.

items.question: Can third-party inspection be arranged?
items.answer: Yes. Buyer-appointed or recognized third-party inspection can be coordinated before shipment by agreement. Inspection scope and timing should be confirmed before production.

items.question: How are stone products packed for export?
items.answer: Packing may include foam, corner protection, cartons, labeled plywood crates, pallets, or A-frames according to product weight, fragility, and shipment method.

items.question: Do you provide private-label or OEM/ODM development?
items.answer: Yes. WHITEROCK can review samples, drawings, packaging, labels, and repeat production needs for qualified programs.

items.question: Which drawing files are most helpful?
items.answer: Dimensioned PDFs are the safest starting point. CAD, DXF, shop drawings, sink templates, hole-center details, and marked revision numbers help reduce clarification cycles.

items.question: Can one order mix multiple SKUs, sizes, or colors?
items.answer: Mixed orders can be reviewed when packing, labeling, production sequence, and container planning are clear. The quotation will confirm whether the mix is practical.

items.question: Can WHITEROCK support color or finish matching?
items.answer: The team can review a physical sample, reference color, finish target, or approved swatch. Final matching must be confirmed by buyer approval before production.

items.question: Are all website product visuals real photos?
items.answer: Owner-supplied photos are used where available. Any generated product, application, or equipment image is labeled as illustrative and should be replaced by real photography when available.

items.question: How do we request a sample kit?
items.answer: Use the color sample builder or inquiry form with your target material, color family, project type, and shipping region. Sample availability and shipping details are confirmed before dispatch.

items.question: Can packaging use buyer labels or private marks?
items.answer: Private-label packaging, carton labels, crate marks, and SKU labels can be reviewed during order setup. Final artwork and marking rules should be approved before production.

items.question: What documents can be prepared for shipment?
items.answer: Commercial documents, packing lists, inspection references, and product-specific documents can be discussed at quotation stage. Certification and test-report claims are published only after owner verification.
